column1: # Shared fixtures for benchmark cases: built ONCE per run by the build under
# test, in $WORK/fx (cwd), visible to cases as ./fx/ (read-only).
# Their wall times are recorded in the results but not compared.
press_pfam1k     S  cp D/pfam_1k.hmm pfam_1k.hmm && hmmpress pfam_1k.hmm
press_dfam15     S  cp D/dfam_pick15.hmm dfam15.hmm && hmmpress dfam15.hmm
pkinase_hmm      S  hmmfetch D/pfam_hitters.hmm Pkinase > pkinase.hmm
pkinase_hits     S  hmmsearch --cpu 8 -A pk_hits.sto -o /dev/null pkinase.hmm D/sprot_50k.fa && esl-reformat fasta pk_hits.sto > pk_hits.fa && rm pk_hits.sto
press_pfam       M  cp D/Pfam-A.hmm Pfam-A.hmm && hmmpress Pfam-A.hmm
press_dfam100    M  cp D/dfam_100.hmm dfam_100.hmm && hmmpress dfam_100.hmm
press_dfam_human L  cp D/dfam_human.hmm dfam_human.hmm && hmmpress dfam_human.hmm
